tagline: A studio for serious creative practice
meta_description: The Groundwork Collective is an education center in Virar West, Maharashtra. 6-month immersive courses in drawing, art, music and expression. WhatsApp us to start.

services.title: 6-month immersive drawing course
services.description: A structured, cohort-based journey in drawing and visual practice. Led by working artists. Small groups. Designed for adults who want a serious creative practice, not a hobby.

services.title: Mind, Art, Music and Expression
services.description: An open studio for art, music, and personal expression. Drop-in sessions, short workshops, and ongoing mentorship depending on what you want to explore.

services.title: Tell us what you want to learn
services.description: If neither of the above fits, send us a message. We design custom tracks for serious learners: portfolio prep, creative re-direction, or specific skills.
